<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0509-fibonacci-number.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def fib(self, n: int) -> int:
        if n == 0:
            return 0
        if n == 1:
            return 1
        f = list(range(n+1))
        f[0] = 0
        f[1] = 1

        for i in range(2,n+1):
            f[i] = f[i-1] + f[i-2]
            print(i)
        
        return f[n]
```
